# Interpersonal regularities (auto-generated)

person-frames: 88553 over four dates, 44889 over the three main dates

| gaze target | share of frames | mean engagement | share at highest level |
|---|---|---|---|

| elsewhere | 18.9% | 23.5 | 12.4% |

## 4. Do co-present participants share an engagement level more often than chance?

- 03_20: pairs sharing a level 42.2% observed against 29.7% expected if independent (7550 pairs)
- 03_26: pairs sharing a level 45.7% observed against 34.0% expected if independent (16124 pairs)
- 05_15: pairs sharing a level 57.1% observed against 33.3% expected if independent (20981 pairs)
- 05_14: pairs sharing a level 59.0% observed against 40.5% expected if independent (43237 pairs)
- **all dates**: 54.7% observed against 36.7% expected, 87892 co-present pairs

## 5. Are engagement changes synchronous across co-present participants?

- 78.3% of level changes have another participant also changing level within 2 s (3499 changes)
- against 65.2% when one participant's change times are shuffled within the session (same marginal rate, no timing relationship)
